Name: ShinyFishMinesFix
Author: qiujk
Description:
[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28183]Shiny Fish[/url] Mines Fix / 矿洞[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28183]闪光鱼[/url]修复[/b]
—— English ——
[b]Overview[/b]
Fixes the issue where mine fish cannot obtain shiny variants from the Shiny Fish mod.
[b]Root Cause[/b]
The Shiny Fish mod hooks the standard fishing API ( GameLocation.GetFishFromLocationData), but mine fish use a hardcoded path (MineShaft.getFish) that bypasses the standard API, preventing mine fish from ever having shiny variants.
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Mine fish (Stonefish, Ice Pip, Lava Eel, etc.) now support shiny variants[/*]
[*]Electric Fish Machine mod's legendary fish and crab pot fish support shiny variants， [b]The original version only supports regular fish.[/b] [/*]
[*]Shiny chance, fish frenzy/bubble bonuses, and Shiny Charm bonus are consistent with the Shiny Fish mod[/*]
[*]Preserves original fish quality[/*]
[/list][b]Dependencies[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI ≥ 4.0.0 — Required[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28183]Shiny Fish [/url]— Required[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45923]Electric Fish Machine[/url] — Optional, auto-detected if installed[/*]
[/list][b]Installation[/b]
Extract to your Mods folder.

—— 中文 ——
[b]简介[/b]
修复闪光鱼模组（Shiny Fish）中矿洞鱼类无法获得闪光变体的问题。
[b]问题原因[/b]
闪光鱼模组 Hook 的是标准钓鱼 API（GameLocation.GetFishFromLocationData），但矿洞鱼类使用硬编码路径（MineShaft.getFish），绕过了标准 API，导致矿洞鱼永远不会出现闪光变体。
[b]功能[/b]
[list]
[*]矿洞鱼类（石头鱼、冰柱鱼、熔岩鳗鱼等）支持闪光变体[/*]
[*]电鱼模组的传说鱼和蟹笼鱼支持闪光变体， 原版只支持普通鱼类 [/*]
[*]闪光概率、鱼狂潮/气泡点加成、闪光护身符加成均与闪光鱼模组一致[/*]
[*]保留原鱼品质[/*]
[/list][b]依赖[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI ≥ 4.0.0 — 必需[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28183]闪光鱼[/url]  — 必需[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45923]电鱼机[/url]  — 可选，安装后自动支持[/*]
[/list][b]安装[/b]
解压到 Mods 文件夹即可。
